subject.title: fix(validation): repair workers reject valid workspace installs

question: Should repair checkout validation treat the PR's authenticated tracked symlink references as an approved exception to resolved-content hashing during dependency setup?
rationale: This is a deliberate integrity-policy expansion rather than a mechanical test or implementation defect; the acceptable trust boundary cannot be inferred safely from the reporter-path proof alone.

options.title: Approve the narrow tracked-reference exception
options.body: Accept the Git-mode normalization and tracked-reference design after confirming the current-main merge result and the intended fail-closed cases.

options.title: Keep resolved-target hashing for links
options.body: Retain the existing stricter symlink identity rule and pursue a narrower workspace-install accommodation only if maintainers define one.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow tracked-reference exception
recommendation.body: Accept the Git-mode normalization and tracked-reference design after confirming the current-main merge result and the intended fail-closed cases.

likelyOwner.reason: The author supplied the concrete trust-boundary design and regression matrix that maintainers need to evaluate.
